lines.beaver: 수아 씨, 노트에 뭘 적고 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Sua, what are you writing in your notebook?
lines.beaver_roman: Sua ssi, noteue mwol jeokgo isseoyo?

lines.beaver_en: Nice. Why did you pick that?
lines.learner: 과정이 결과보다 중요하다. 그게 제 생각이에요.
lines.en: The process matters more than the result. That's what I think.
lines.roman: Gwajeongi gyeolgwaboda jungyohada. Geuge je saenggagieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. How do you build your skills?
lines.learner: 매일 연습해요. 그래서 솜씨가 조금씩 늘어요.
lines.en: I practice every day. So my skill improves little by little.
lines.roman: Maeil yeonseupaeyo. Geuraeseo somssiga jogeumssik neureoyo.

lines.beaver_en: You'll be a role model for juniors too.
lines.en: To be a role model, you need a sense of responsibility.
Yes. "Even with skill, I don't show off."

lines.beaver: 좌우명 말고 평소에 지키려는 태도도 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Besides mottos, is there an attitude you try to keep every day?
lines.beaver_roman: Jwaumyeong malgo pyosoe jikiryeoneun taedodo isseoyo?
lines.learner: 올바른 길은 어렵지만 그 길을 갈 거예요.
lines.en: The right path is hard, but I'll take it.
lines.roman: Olbareun gireun eoryeopjiman geu gireul gal geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: What do you do when it's tough?
lines.en: That's when I need courage. I don't give up.

lines.beaver_en: What if you make a mistake?
lines.en: Mistakes are my responsibility, so I fix them well.

lines.beaver: 정말 멋진 좌우명이에요. 어디에 붙일 거예요?
lines.beaver_en: What great mottos. Where will you put them?
lines.beaver_roman: Jeongmal meotjin jwaumyeongieyo. Eodie buchil geoyeyo?
lines.learner: 책상 앞에 붙이고 매일 읽을 거예요.
lines.en: I'll stick them by my desk and read them daily.
lines.roman: Chaeksang ape buchigo maeil ilgeul geoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 수아 씨는 꼭 잘할 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: Great. I'm sure you'll do well, Sua.
lines.beaver_roman: Joayo. Sua ssineun kkok jalhal geoyeyo.
lines.en: Thanks, sunbae. Today too, I do my best!
